## Company Overview

Fluxco operates in Energy & Sustainability and is based in Austin, Texas. Its latest recorded funding round was a Seed round in July 2026.

Fluxco is an industrial technology company that provides an AI-powered procurement platform for electrical grid infrastructure, specifically streamlining the sourcing and lifecycle management of electrical transformers.
